name: Gem of Cobrahn
summary: In the Wailing Caverns, Lord Cobrahn bears a dream gem shaped by corruption. Nara Wildmane needs it as proof of his defeat.

sections.title: A Focus of Corrupted Dreams
sections.body: Naralex entered the Emerald Dream to restore Kalimdor's barren plains. His nightmare twisted the Wailing Caverns and turned his disciples from their purpose. Cobrahn forsook the peaceful ways of the Cenarion Circle and took the shape of a serpent. He now carries one of four dream gems that anchor the leaders' hold over the subterranean waterways. Through it, he channels twisted dreams that threaten to make the Barrens a venomous marsh.

sections.title: Restoring Balance
sections.body: Nara Wildmane, a tauren druid in Thunder Bluff, suffers nightmares sent by the rogue Druids of the Fang. She seeks to cleanse the subterranean springs and protect Kalimdor from their vision. Lord Cobrahn and his three conspirators each hold a dream gem. Returning Cobrahn's gem to the Cenarion druids ends his corrupting influence over the sleeping Naralex.

faq.q: What is the Gem of Cobrahn?
faq.answer: In the Wailing Caverns, Lord Cobrahn carries the Gem of Cobrahn. The dream gem channels his nightmare-twisted power.

faq.q: Who wants the Gem of Cobrahn?
faq.answer: Nara Wildmane, a tauren druid on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, wants the Gem of Cobrahn and three others to end the Druids of the Fang.

faq.q: How many gems are needed to complete the quest?
faq.answer: Four gems are needed: the Gem of Cobrahn, the Gem of Anacondra, the Gem of Pythas, and the Gem of Serpentis. Each is held by one of the four serpent leaders in the caverns.
Lord Cobrahn was once a disciple of Naralex. When Naralex's vision became a nightmare, Cobrahn and several other druids took serpent form and formed the Druids of the Fang.

angles.text: As a Cenarion druid, reclaiming the Gem of Cobrahn marks the tragic but necessary end of a fallen brother who left nature's harmony for the Emerald Nightmare.
As a tauren, you know the druids of Thunder Bluff watch the Barrens closely. Taking Cobrahn's gem directly protects the plains and hunting grounds from unnatural corruption.
